utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'm... not sure what I can offer. But I'll check my garage later.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good. Let me know what you find—especially if you have any wrenches or screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'll see what's in there. It's been a while since I opened that box.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I've talked to Oren and Vik about it—they're both coming. It's definitely on Saturday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You say Oren and Vik are coming? I'll believe it when I see them there with their tools.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Well, you can come by Saturday and see for yourself—I'll be there with my toolbox, and I bet Oren and Vik will show up too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Rosa, I heard about a repair drive going on. Are you involved in that? Need any help?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Sam! Yes, I'm coordinating it. Thanks for offering! Just so you know, we've moved it to Sunday at the community center. Can I count on you then?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Rosa, you can count on me. I'll be there on Sunday to lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, I'd better check my shed to see what’s actually useful besides that old lawnmower.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Good idea, Eli. Let me know what you find—I want to be sure we're bringing things that'll actually be useful.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Will do, Hana. I'll take a proper inventory this afternoon and let you know before supper.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I'm not sure about flathead screwdrivers, but I can check with the Hernandez family if you'd like.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That would be great, Mara. Please do check—I want to make sure we have everything we need.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I'll head over to the Hernandez place right now and ask about the flathead screwdrivers. I'll let you know as soon as I find out.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive, yeah. I think I saw something about that—is it still happening this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yes, this Saturday at the community center from 10 to 4 — I'm thinking of bringing my old toaster, maybe they can fix it up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, a toaster, huh? I've got a blender that's been acting up—maybe I'll swing by too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, Hana, I saw a couple of vans and some toolboxes — maybe four or five folks working together.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, so it's actually happening? I thought it was just talk. Who's organizing it?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Not sure who exactly is running it, but they had a clipboard and were checking things off like a real plan.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Vik, are you planning to join the repair drive this weekend? Do you have any tools we can use?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes, definitely! The repair drive is this Saturday at the community center from 10 to 4 — they'll have folks who can fix just about anything, and I'm bringing my toaster. Do you have anything that needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: A toaster? That's a start, but I was hoping for practical tools like a drill or wrenches. Do you have any of those?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, Jules, do we have a clear plan for where everyone's supposed to meet and what to bring? I just want to make sure we're not running around confused on the day.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great point, Pia! I was thinking we could meet at the old community center parking lot—I've already got a list of tool requests from Opal, so I can share that with you.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, that's good to hear you have a list. Can you send it to me so I can double-check what I'm supposed to bring?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: So Tess, I keep hearing about this repair drive—Mina mentioned it's to help folks who can't afford fixes. You know anything more about when it's starting?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard it's this weekend, but I'm not sure about the exact start time—maybe we could check the community center's notice board?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Good idea, I'll swing by the community center later and take a look at that board.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I think it's this Saturday. Rosa was asking for volunteers—are you planning to join?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, this Saturday? I wasn't sure if it was still on. But yes, I'd love to volunteer—let me know what Rosa needs.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can check with Rosa and let you know. She seemed pretty organized about it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks Gus. I think I might have a toolbox somewhere, but sure, bring 'em over.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Alright, I'll bring my wrenches and toolbox Saturday morning. Need anything else?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Saturday morning? Hmm, I thought you were coming by after lunch. Well, sure, sounds good.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, Dane! I'm so glad I ran into you. The repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, Sunday at the community center? Thanks for the heads-up, Rosa—I almost showed up at the wrong place and time.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course, Dane! Sorry for the last-minute change, but I think the community center will give us more room to work. Want me to put you down for a specific task?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive? I think I heard something about that. Works better if you tighten the screws, right?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Right. I'm handling the tool inventory Saturday at 9. Need anything specific?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: No, I'm good—just point me at something to tighten and I'll be fine.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Nell, I heard you're organizing a repair drive. I've got some extra tools if you need 'em.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I'm not actually organizing it—I just heard rumors. But thanks for offering tools! Maybe we can direct them to the real organizers?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Oh, so who's the point person then? I wanna make sure my tools get to the right spot.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, the repair drive? I haven't heard much about it. What's the latest?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, from what I gather, it's this Saturday morning — folks are bringing tools to fix up old appliances and such.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Saturday morning, huh? I wonder if my old drill would be any use — it's been gathering dust for ages.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you point me to where you heard that? I'd like to see some proof before I believe it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Honestly, I'm still trying to sort through the noise myself—let's both hold off until we have something more concrete.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright, I'll wait with you. But I still need to see something solid before I'm convinced.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I've been stocking up on spare parts for the repair drive this Saturday—it's definitely happening at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good to know it's definitely happening, but I'm still a bit nervous about the parking—Tess mentioned they're setting up an overflow lot behind the bakery, but I hope it's clearly marked.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Don't worry about parking—I saw the signs they put up this morning, they're easy to spot.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Opal's working on a GPS? Maybe I'll swing by and see if she can look at my old radio.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That sounds like a good idea, Uli. Opal's real handy with electronics, I'm sure she'd take a look at your radio.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam. I'll see if I can find that radio and bring it by.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Opal, have you heard about the repair drive? I've been telling everyone about it!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, Mara mentioned the Hernandez family offered screws and hinges—those should come in handy.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, that's great to hear! I've been spreading the word too—we're going to have a fantastic turnout with all these donations rolling in.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Jules, are you coming to the repair drive? Do you have any tools we can borrow?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes, I'll be there! I've got some old screwdrivers and wrenches I can bring.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, we'll need those. You don't happen to have a power drill as well, do you?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Tess, I'm glad you're here! Faye just asked about a list for the repair drive—do you have any ideas on what else we might need?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, good question! My cousin mentioned they're hoping people will bring their own screwdrivers and such, just in case. Maybe we should add that to the list.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great idea, Tess! I'll add 'bring your own tools' to the list—maybe we can put together a sign-up sheet too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey, I saw Eli's ready to go early—I'll bring some spare parts, count me in for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Saturday? Yeah, that sounds familiar. I think I was supposed to organize something by then, but I'm not entirely sure what.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, Rosa's organizing a repair drive this Saturday. Eli's bringing his toolbox. Maybe that's what you're thinking of?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Jules mentioned needing old wrenches—did you say you had some to contribute, Oren?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Wrenches? Oh, I think I was talking about a toaster. I must have mixed it up. But I do have that old toaster somewhere—should I bring it?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: A toaster, huh? That might be useful too, but Jules specifically asked for wrenches. Let me double-check with Jules before you bring anything.
